evidence.title: Situated Agent design principle
evidence.content: A situated agent is one whose engineering effort goes into context assembly rather than raw reasoning. A well-situated 27B beats a poorly-situated frontier model on personal or contextual work because the per-turn prompt carries the user's history, the relevant memories, the active goal, and the right tool surface. The principle drives all routing and handler design across sovereign + commonwealth.

evidence.title: decision note
evidence.content: Selected the situated-agent framing over a 'reasoning-first' framing because the former scales with curation effort (which is bounded) while the latter scales with model size (which we don't control on a personal node).
